channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2X Monster Trucks Live: Milton, FL 2026 (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · Afternoon doors 10:00 AM · Evening doors 5:00 PM | Southern Raceway | No published price. Southern Raceway hosts two Monster Trucks Live shows the same day. The afternoon show has doors at 10:00 AM, a pit party from 10:00 to 11:30 AM, racing noon to 2:00 PM, and autographs at 2:15 PM. The evening show has doors at 5:00 PM, a pit party from 5:00 to 6:30 PM, racing 7:00 to 9:00 PM, and autographs at 9:15 PM. The event is ticketed. A separate $15 ride-truck ticket is sold on top, with kids age 2 and under riding free on a parent's lap.

item.title: A Gentleman's Guide to Love and Murder at UWF (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fri 11/6, Sat 11/7, Fri 11/13, Sat 11/14 at 7:30 PM · Sun 11/8 and Sun 11/15 at 2:30 PM | Besser Studio Theatre, UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts | No published price. UWF Theatre stages the Tony-winning musical comedy about a poor young man who plots his way past the relatives ahead of him in line for an earldom. There are four evening shows at 7:30 PM and two Sunday matinees at 2:30 PM. UWF says adult situations and subject matter may make the show inappropriate for some audiences.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Nov 24 · mostly 2 PM to 6 PM, 2 PM to 5 PM from Nov 16 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Alys Beach Crafted (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Wednesday 11/11 to Sunday 11/15 · times vary by event | Alys Beach | No published price. Alys Beach Crafted is a five-day festival that benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County. The schedule opens with a songwriters session on Wednesday and has cocktail and wine dinners on Thursday, Firkin Fete on Friday and Spirited Soiree on Saturday. Most of the events are for adults, and the free Holiday Makers Market is the easiest family stop.

item.title: Barnwell Community Spud Run 5K (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 5K 8:00 AM, Couch Potato Fun Run 9:00 AM | Barnwell Community Center area | from $30. The Spud Run helps restore the historic Barnwell Community Center near Fairhope, with a 5K at 8 AM and a 1 mile Couch Potato Fun Run at 9 AM. A Barbecue and Spuds Festival follows with crafts vendors, live music, beer and barbecue, and bounce houses and face painting for kids. The student 5K and the no-shirt fun run are free.

item.title: Chrissy Chlapecka at The Handlebar (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM | The Handlebar | from $25. Pop singer Chrissy Chlapecka plays The Handlebar on a Saturday night. The ticket page lists the show as all ages, with tickets from $25 to $75. Doors open at 7 PM and the show starts at 8 PM.

item.title: Christmas Lighted Night Market, Perdido Key (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Friday 11/13 · 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM · Saturday 11/14 · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | The Villagio Perdido Town Centre | Free. The Perdido Key Area Chamber of Commerce hosts a Christmas market under the lights at the Villagio Town Centre on Perdido Key. Come Friday evening or Saturday morning for early holiday shopping.

item.title: Clay hand building class at Coastal Makers (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM or 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM | Coastal Makers | $60 for two. Lana Hall teaches clay hand building at Coastal Makers in Mobile. The class is open to ages 12 and up and holds at most 10 people. The fee covers glaze and two firings, so finished pieces come back later. A $30 deposit holds a spot.

item.title: Cliff Ellis and The River Swampers at Downtown Music Hall (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · Doors 6:00 PM · Show 7:00 PM | Downtown Music Hall | from $20. Cliff Ellis, a Hall of Fame basketball coach who began his coaching career in Niceville, returns to his roots as a musician with The River Swampers at Downtown Music Hall. The band plays a throwback set of songs from the 1960s, 1970s and 1980s, including songs Ellis recorded himself. The show is all ages, with doors at 6:00 PM and music at 7:00 PM.

item.title: Crestview R.E.A.D. (reading to a therapy dog) (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Second Saturday of the month: 11/14, 12/12 | Crestview Library | No published price. Crestview R.E.A.D. is a reading program at Crestview Library where children read one-on-one for 20 minutes with a trained therapy dog named Hattie. It is recommended for ages 4 to 12 who can read or are learning to. A parent must stay with their child.

item.title: F100 Gulf Coast National and Classic Ford Show (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Thursday 11/12 to Saturday 11/14 · hours not published | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds, Buildings 1 and 6 and the Midway | No published price. The Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds lists the F100 Gulf Coast National and Classic Ford Show across Buildings 1 and 6 and the Midway for three days. The fairgrounds page gives no hours, price or organizer link. Call the fair office at (850) 944-4500 before driving out.

item.title: Fairhope Film Festival (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Thursday 11/12 to Sunday 11/15 | Fairhope Film Festival, Fairhope | No published price. The Fairhope Film Festival brings independent films to the big screen in downtown Fairhope for four days in November. The 2026 opening night film, Luck My Life, is a comedy about a mahjong player who loses his luck, and it makes its first United States appearance here. The festival's home page lists no venues, schedule or ticket prices yet, so sign up for its newsletter or call before you plan the evening.

item.title: Festa Italiana (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fri 11/13 and Sat 11/14 · hours for the new dates not posted yet | Fountain Park, downtown Pensacola | Free. The Buona Fortuna Lodge turns Fountain Park in downtown Pensacola into an Italian street fair with shrimp scampi, spaghetti and meatballs, lasagna, sausage and pepper sandwiches and tiramisu. There is Italian music, a silent auction, a cash prize drawing and a Kids Corner with face painting and balloons. Proceeds go to the lodge's charitable donations and scholarships in the Pensacola area. Confirm the dates and hours with the lodge before you go.

item.title: Finding Neverland at Joe Jefferson Playhouse (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fridays and Saturdays 7:30 PM · Sundays 2:30 PM | Joe Jefferson Playhouse | from $26.75. Joe Jefferson Players stage Finding Neverland, the musical about playwright J.M. Barrie and how he came to write Peter Pan. Shows run three weekends, Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets are $26.75.

item.title: Foley Rotary Oyster Run 5K (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 5K 8:00 AM, 1 mile 9:00 AM | Orange Blossom Square, Downtown Foley | from $25. The 33rd Foley Rotary Oyster Run starts in Orange Blossom Square downtown, with 5K run, walk and wheelchair divisions and a one mile fun run. Runners get a shirt while they last, and the after-party has beer, raw oysters and gumbo. Proceeds go to the Alabama Sheriff's Boys Ranch, the South Baldwin Literacy Council and other local charities.

item.title: Frank Brown International Songwriters' Festival (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Thu 11/5 to Sun 11/15 · times vary by stage | Flora-Bama Lounge and more than two dozen stages along the Gulf Coast | No published price. More than 200 songwriters play over 600 performances on more than two dozen stages along the Florida and Alabama Gulf Coast during this 11-day festival, which grew out of the Flora-Bama on Perdido Key. Songwriters tell the stories behind their songs, from Grammy winners to rising talent. Many shows are free, and some are ticketed or charge a cover.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Guys and Dolls at Stage Crafters (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fri 11/6 to Sun 11/15 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM | Stage Crafters Theatre | from $32. Stage Crafters stages the Damon Runyon musical comedy Guys and Dolls over two weekends in November. Gambler Nathan Detroit hunts for cash to run the biggest craps game in New York while his fiancee Adelaide waits out a fourteen-year engagement. The company bills itself as Florida's oldest all-volunteer community theatre, now in its 54th year.

item.title: Holiday Makers Market at Alys Beach Crafted (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Friday 11/13 · 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM · Saturday 11/14 and Sunday 11/15 · 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM | Alys Beach Amphitheatre | Free. Regional artisans show and talk about their work at the Alys Beach Amphitheatre, and you can buy handmade holiday gifts. There is live music, plus food and drinks from Town Center merchants, and Santa poses for photos from noon to 2 PM on Saturday and Sunday. The Cultural Arts Alliance booth lets kids and adults make something to take home.

item.title: Ice skating rink presented by Pepsi at The Wharf (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Daily from 11/13 · hours vary by day | The Wharf | from $16. The Wharf in Orange Beach opens a real ice rink for the holiday season on November 13 and keeps it open through January 18. Skates are provided, beginners are welcome, and a DJ plays Friday and Saturday nights from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays through December 8 the Wharf donates $5 to Toys for Tots for each skate purchase.

item.title: Jailbreak 5K (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 8:00 AM start, packet pickup 6:30 AM | Mardi Gras Park | from $25. The Jailbreak 5K starts at Mardi Gras Park in downtown Mobile on Saturday morning. Youth 12 and under pay less than adults, and there is an age group for 9 and under. Finisher's medals go to the first 200 runners across the line.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Junior League of Mobile Christmas Jubilee (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fri 11/13 · 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM · Sat 11/14 · 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM · Sun 11/15 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Arthur R. Outlaw Mobile Convention Center | from $5. The Junior League of Mobile's 42nd annual Christmas Jubilee fills the Mobile Convention Center with merchants from around the country for three days of holiday shopping. Friday offers VIP shopping for guests 21 and older, and concessions and a cash bar for adults are available during market hours. The market raises money for local agencies and programs in Mobile and Baldwin Counties.

item.title: Mahjong at the Mansion at Bragg-Mitchell (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Tuesday 11/10 · Tuesday 11/17 · time not posted | Bragg-Mitchell Mansion | No published price. The Bragg-Mitchell Mansion in Mobile hosts Mahjong at the Mansion on Tuesday November 10 and Tuesday November 17. The mansion's home page lists the two dates with a registration link. It prints no start time and no price.

item.title: Main Street Crestview Holiday Market (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 | Historic Downtown Crestview, Main Street | No published price. The Main Street Crestview Association holds its annual Holiday Market in downtown Crestview under a Storybook Christmas theme. The listing names local shopping, photos with Santa, train rides and a beer tent. Hours and admission are not published yet, so confirm both before driving up.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 11/14)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mobile In Noir: An R&B, Southern Soul & Hip Hop Story (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 8:30 PM (doors 7:30 PM) | Saenger Theatre | No published price. Mobile In Noir is a black tie concert at the Saenger Theatre in Mobile on Saturday, November 14 at 8:30 PM, with doors at 7:30 PM. The show celebrates R&B, Southern soul and hip hop, orchestrated by The Collective, with performances by J-Simon, Elijah McCreary, Multi Parrish, LyriK, Rich Boy, Mr. Campbell, Jukebox Brass Band and DJ Rodski.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition by Mark Alan Francis (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Weekdays | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Mark Alan Francis shows landscape photographs made with the Mordançage process, which leaves copper, tan and burnt sienna tones in black-and-white silver gelatin prints. The prints look as if they were shot at night under moonlight. The show hangs in the Switzer Gallery from November 5 through December 11.

item.title: Nighttime with Carson Taylor (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 9:30 PM (doors 9:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | from $20.56. Nighttime with Carson Taylor is a live take on a late-night talk show hosted by Mobile comedian Carson Taylor with a cast of local talent. It starts at 9:30 PM at the Crescent Theater, so it works as a late cap to a Saturday downtown. The show is for ages 18 and up.

item.title: Noises Off!: Chickasaw Civic Theatre (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Nov 12-22, 2026 · eves + matinees | Chickasaw Civic Theatre | No published price. Michael Frayn's door-slamming backstage farce, one of the funniest plays ever written, plays at Chickasaw's community playhouse.

item.title: Opry in the Barn: Kelly Crabb and The Bowling Sisters (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · open house 5:00 PM, dinner 6:00 PM, concert 6:30 PM | My Father's Arrows | Free. My Father's Arrows, a ministry to foster children in Jay, hosts a gospel night in its barn with Kelly Crabb and The Bowling Sisters. The evening starts with an open house of the campus, then a free dinner at 6 PM and the concert at 6:30 PM, with fellowship and a silent auction. Admission is free, but tickets must be reserved.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Photos with Santa at The Wharf (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Fridays to Sundays 11/13 to 12/24 · Fri 3 PM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 6 PM, Sun 12 PM to 6 PM | The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach sets up Photos with Santa on Fridays through Sundays from November 13 to December 24. Friday hours run 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The Wharf sells various price packages, and the ice rink sits next door at the same property.

item.title: Pilates and Pumpkins at Holland Farms (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Friday 11/6 · 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM · Sunday 11/15 · 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM | Holland Farms | from $20. Holland Farms holds two more Pilates and Pumpkins classes on the farm in November. The Friday November 6 session runs from 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM, and the Sunday November 15 session runs from 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM. The class is $20 a person, bought online by date. All sales are final.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Qigong classes at Historic Blakeley (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM · Saturday 11/21 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $10. Historic Blakeley State Park offers guided Qigong, a slow, low-impact practice that combines movement, deep breathing and visualization and is described as an ancestor of Tai Chi. Classes run from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 11/7 and Saturday 11/21, with an optional group hike afterward. They take place rain or shine unless there is lightning or severe weather.

item.title: R&B Only Live at Vinyl Music Hall (SAT 11/14)
item.description: Saturday 11/14 · 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM | Vinyl Music Hall | from $55. Colors Worldwide brings its R&B Only Live party to Vinyl Music Hall, a late night of R&B from 8 PM to about 1 AM. It is 18 and over with a valid ID, and tickets are standing room only. The organizer lists general admission at $55 to $110.
